confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are medium confidence; accommodation anchors are lower confidence because Jeonju has a smaller hotel and hostel market than Seoul or Busan. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages, and the F11 table itself was not opened or verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized South Korean cities (e.g., Daegu, Gwangju, Daejeon) with similar restaurant and accommodation price levels, adjusted for Jeonju's lower costs relative to the capital and major port cities.
